component.name: Kulan Settings
component.summary: Appearance, dock, updates and add-ons for Kulan OS

description.p: One place for every Kulan OS option, from how the desktop looks to updates, restore points and optional add-ons.

ul.li: Light, dark or automatic appearance, accent colour, wallpaper and window buttons
A dock that stays visible, shows on hover or hides when covered
Top bar, animations, app folders, Night Light, text size and keyboard
Choose which apps open when you sign in
Updates, release notes and restore points in Software Update
Add the Developer Kit, office apps and media apps in one click

description.p: First release: Kulan Settings replaces Update Center.
